title: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948

sections.shortTitle: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) ORDINANCE, 1948.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948.
(2) It extends to the Capital of the Federation.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Interpretation

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) ORDINANCE, 1948.
2. Interpretation.-In this Ordinance "Schedule" means
the Schedule to this Ordinance ; "specified area" means any area
specified in the Schedule ; and "transfer" means a transfer within
the meaning of section 5 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, and its
grammatical variations shall be construed accordingly.

sections.shortTitle: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Central Government to approve land transfers

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) ORDINANCE, 1948.
3. Central Government to approve land transfers.-No person shall
transfer any land lying within the specified area except with the prior
approval of the Central Government in writing and any transfer made in
contravention of this section shall be void.

sections.shortTitle: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Market value in case of acquisition

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) ORDINANCE, 1948.
4. Market value in case of acquisition.-Notwithstanding anything
to the contrary in any other enactment for the time being in force, the market
value of any land lying within the specified area shall, for the purposes of
determining the amount of compensation to be awarded therefor, if such land is
acquired after the 31st March 1948, in pursuance of a notification under
subsection (1) of section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, or by a notice
under subsection (3) of section 3 of the Sind (Requisition of Land) Act, 1947,
be the lower market value of the land determined with reference to its market
value.
(a) on the 31st March 1948, and (b) on the date of the
notification or, as the case may be, of the notice aforesaid.

sections.shortTitle: Land Control Capital of the Federation Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Power to amend schedule

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1948
LAND CONTROL (CAPITAL OF THE FEDERATION) ORDINANCE, 1948.
5. Power to amend Schedule.-The Central Government may, by an
order published in the Official Gazette, alter the boundaries of any specified
area, or omit any such area from the Schedule, or add any area to the Schedule
making it thereupon a specified area, and the Schedule thereupon be deemed to
be amended accordingly.
